text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains, with Ethereum outpacing Bitcoin slightly, suggesting selective strength in altcoins despite BTC's dominant market share holding steady at 59%. The Fear & Greed index sits at neutral 51 with a downward 7-day trend, indicating cautious sentiment as traders remain unconvinced of sustained momentum. Total volume of $63B is moderate, pointing to deliberate positioning rather than panic-driven movement in either direction.
